parsed.name: 单路数据流工具
parsed.description: 用于实验中打开数据文件、记录时间区间并运行单路数据流处理的非实体软件组件。它更像是实验数据采集或流式记录辅助程序，而不是直接控制物理仪器的设备。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component used in experiments to open data files, record time intervals, and run single-stream data handling. It appears to be a helper for data acquisition or streaming/logging rather than direct control of a physical instrument.

actions.description: 打开用于实验数据流的文件。
actions.description_en: Open a file used for experimental data streaming.

actions.description: 运行单路数据流处理或记录过程。
actions.description_en: Run the single-stream data processing or logging routine.
